name: Cherry Jam ~Kanojo ga Hadaka ni Kigaetara~
original_name: チェリージャム ～彼女が裸に着替えたら～
source:
Cherry Jam is a visual novel with a slight inclination towards dating simulation. The hero is a nameless young man who is dating a girl named Tomoyo. The game is dedicated to their relationship, more precisely the dates they have together. As usually in visual novels, the basic premise is a flow of text accompanying still images, with occasional decisions that steer the story in a different direction. However, in Cherry Jam the player has to choose the protagonist's answers or actions very frequently. Those decisions influence Tomoyo's mood and eventually the outcome of the date. Many decisions also lead to a premature end of the game.

The player also has to manage the protagonist's finances. Presents for Tomoyo and other expenses are deduced from the protagonist's overall wealth, so the player has to balance between keeping Tomoyo happy and not becoming broke. 

There is a "novel mode" in the game, which becomes accessible after the first game "death". This mode re-tells the entire story so far from the point of view of Tomoyo.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cherry-jam-kanojo-ga-hadaka-ni-kigaetara]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Cherry Jam》是一款略带恋爱模拟倾向的视觉小说。主人公是一名没有名字的年轻人，正与名叫智代的女孩交往。游戏聚焦于两人的关系，更准确地说，是他们一次又一次的约会。和大多数视觉小说一样，基本玩法是阅读配合静态图片呈现的文字，并偶尔作出决定，将故事引向不同方向。不过，《Cherry Jam》要求玩家极为频繁地选择主人公的回答或行动。这些决定会影响智代的心情，并最终改变约会结果；许多选择还会令游戏提前结束。

玩家也必须管理主人公的财务状况。送给智代的礼物及其他开销都会从总资产中扣除，因此必须在讨智代开心和避免破产之间取得平衡。

游戏还设有“小说模式”，第一次遭遇游戏“死亡”后便会解锁。该模式将从智代的视角，重新讲述此前发生的全部故事。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cherry-jam-kanojo-ga-hadaka-ni-kigaetara]Moby Games[/url]]
